name: Schema.org MedicalEntity
description: Adds Schema.org/MedicalEntity to the JSON-LD array. Creates MedicalEntity, LifestyleModification, MedicalIndication or MedicalIntangible.
project_description:
This module creates the following Schema.org object types:

 
 Schema.org/MedicalEntity 
 Schema.org/AnatomicalStructure 
 Schema.org/AnatomicalSystem 
 Schema.org/Drug 
 Schema.org/DrugClass 
 Schema.org/DrugCost 
 Schema.org/LifestyleModification 
 Schema.org/MedicalCause 
 Schema.org/MedicalCondition 
 Schema.org/MedicalContraindication 
 Schema.org/MedicalDevice 
 Schema.org/MedicalGuideline 
 Schema.org/MedicalIndication 
 Schema.org/MedicalIntangible 
 Schema.org/MedicalProcedure 
 Schema.org/MedicalRiskEstimator 
 Schema.org/MedicalRiskFactor 
 Schema.org/MedicalStudy 
 Schema.org/MedicalTest 
 Schema.org/MedicalWebPage 
 Schema.org/Physician 
 Schema.org/Substance 
 Schema.org/SuperficialAnatomy 
 
 It extends Schema.org Metatag (schema_metatag), which owns JSON-LD assembly and token replacement. The base module provides the MedicalEntity group, its Tag plugins and shared PropertyType/Base classes; each of the 18 submodules adds one top-level medical type. The module was created per maintainer's recommendations in [#3116016].
